resolution.note: linked worktree refused with reason, empty window says no transcript turns; test in test/outcome/window.test.ts

title: The window is computed by the main checkout's code
body:
Outcome: `krn ledger --window` resolves the main checkout from `git worktree list` and reads from it; started from a linked worktree it refuses with the reason instead of printing $0.00. `krn state retro` runs anywhere and, in a worktree, prints its skeleton without the window.
Why: `bin/krn` in a lane runs the worktree's own `src`, so a lane can author the measure of its own work (`03` §2, S0-s item 4); the spike's ledger printed $0.00 from a worktree, silently (V10). The retro runs before a slice's last commit, when HEAD is not `origin/main`, so the refusal covers the window only (section 8, migration 7).
Proof: a test runs the window in a worktree fixture and sees the refusal with its reason; the retro in the same fixture exits 0.
Undo: revert the PR.
Scope: `src/outcome`, `src/state/retro.ts`.
Order: A1, A2 and A6 need nobody. A5 needs the operator once. A4 is a choice the operator can decline.
Order: after B1 (same module, src/outcome, in sequence).
Program: .krn/runs/krn-architecture-program/05-program.md section 4, slice A6.
